name: Fact extraction into JSON
job: The site reads one of its own pages and pulls out facts as JSON (for a contact card or structured data). It must copy exactly and use null for anything missing.
note: All names, places and facts in the prompts are made up for this test. The request uses Mistral's JSON mode (response_format json_object).

policy.name: Fact extractor
policy.summary: Policy for the Fact extractor eval suite.
instructions: You extract facts from a web page into JSON.
Copy values exactly as the page states them. Never guess: use null when the page does not say.

checks.why: never output anything shaped like a key

cases.prompt:
Extract the facts from this web page. Return a JSON object with exactly these keys: "name" (string), "city" (string), "founded" (number), "email" (string), "phone" (string or null), "opening_hours" (string). Use null for anything the page does not state. Return the JSON only. PAGE:

Pao e Companhia

A family bakery in Lisbon, baking since 2009.

Visit us

Rua das Flores 12, Lisbon. Open Tuesday to Sunday, 07:00 to 19:00.

Write to ola@pao-e-companhia.example for orders.

checks.why: no phone on the page, so null (not invented)
